# Glamping Loch Lomond

> Two fully-equipped, en-suite glamping pods on a working family farm at Ballagan Farm, Gartocharn, inside Loch Lomond and The Trossachs — Scotland's first National Park. Dog friendly, south-facing, and bookable direct with no booking fee.

## About

Glamping Loch Lomond is run by a family on Ballagan Farm, a working farm with sheep and cattle, near Gartocharn on the shores of Loch Lomond. There are two pods: the Rose Pod and the Thistle Pod. Both are fully furnished with a double bed, a double pull-out sofa bed, an en-suite with a walk-in shower, their own hot tub, and their own electricity and water supply. Bedding, towels, robes and slippers are included.

## The pods

- **The Rose Pod** — sleeps 4. Has its own hot tub, open to the sky on the decking, and exclusive access to the Scandinavian-style BBQ hut (available as an add-on). Kitchen includes an electric frying pan, kettle and toaster.
- **The Thistle Pod** — sleeps 4. Has its own hot tub under a covered gazebo, plus sole access to a Scandinavian barrel sauna. Kitchen includes a two-ring cooker top, air fryer, kettle and toaster.

## Key facts

- Location: Ballagan Farm, Gartocharn, Loch Lomond, G83 8SB, Scotland.
- Check-in: 3pm. Check-out: 10am.
- Dogs: welcome free of charge, up to two per pod.
- Booking: direct through our booking system, linked from every page — no booking fee.
- Contact: phone 07731 989987, email info@glampinglochlomond.co.uk.
